name: Pendo MCP
description: Query Pendo product analytics, visitor and account data, and in-app guides from Claude, Cursor, or ChatGPT. For product and customer success teams.

skills.name: Page And Feature Usage
skills.description: Queries Page, Feature, and Track Event usage and runs event-level aggregation queries on recent usage in your Pendo apps.

skills.name: Visitor And Account Data
skills.description: Retrieves visitor and account metadata from Pendo and analyzes visitor activity and engagement patterns for a segment.

skills.name: Guides, Surveys, And Ideas
skills.description: Searches for and retrieves Pendo guides, surveys, and ideas, so an agent can surface walkthrough links in its answers.

skills.name: Orchestrate Journeys
skills.description: Lists and retrieves Orchestrate journeys and emails, including their configuration, journey steps, and performance metrics.

skills.name: Feedback And Segment Writes
skills.description: Creates feedback items and ideas and creates or updates segments, once a subscription admin turns on Pendo's write tools.
